title: HealBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Psychological Comfort in Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: HealBench：用于评估文本生成图像中心理安抚性的细粒度基准

paragraphs.en: 总结：HealBench是一个评估文本生成图像中心理安抚性的细粒度基准，揭示视觉质量与情感舒适度之间的差距。 Despite advances in photorealism, semantic fidelity, and aesthetics, text-to-image generation and image editing remain understudied in a human-centered dimension: whether their outputs feel psychologically comforting. Grounded in cognitive evaluation theory, we define psychological comfort as an affective response shaped by viewers' appraisal of restorative and emotionally supportive visual cues. We introduce HealBench, a fine-grained benchmark of 30,000 high-quality image-text pairs spanning 19 categories and 92 subcategories, selected from 100,000 candidates through a human- and expert-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language model matching, human preference models, expert filtering, and exemplar-guided augmentation. We also construct HealBench-Eval, a feature-clustered evaluation set of 1,095 instances. Using HealBench-Eval, we conduct objective and subjective evaluations of 14 representative image generation models and prompt-rewriting strategies. Results reveal a gap between conventional visual quality and perceived comfort: strong semantic alignment and aesthetics do not guarantee emotionally restorative images. Reinforcement learning experiments further show that HealScorer can serve as a reward signal for assessing and improving the emotional and restorative quality of generated images. These findings establish psychological comfort as a distinct dimension of human-centered image generation and position HealBench as a foundation for affect-aware generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：HealBench是一个评估文本生成图像中心理安抚性的细粒度基准，揭示了视觉质量与情感舒适度之间的差距。尽管在照片级真实感、语义保真度和美学方面已取得进展，文本生成图像与图像编辑在以人为本的维度上仍未得到充分研究：其输出是否能给人带来心理上的慰藉。 基于认知评价理论，我们将心理舒适定义为一种情感反应，它由观看者对恢复性与情感支持性视觉线索的评价所塑造。 我们提出HealBench，一个包含30,000对高质量图文的细粒度基准，涵盖19个大类和92个子类，这些样本是从100,000个候选中通过一个人机与专家在环的流程筛选而来，该流程结合了视觉语言模型匹配、人类偏好模型、专家过滤以及示例引导的扩充。 我们还构建了HealBench-Eval，一个由1,095个实例组成的按特征聚类的评估集。 利用HealBench-Eval，我们对14个具有代表性的图像生成模型和提示词改写策略进行了客观与主观评估。 结果揭示了传统视觉质量与感知舒适之间的差距：强语义对齐和美学表现并不能保证图像具有情感恢复性。 强化学习实验进一步表明，HealScorer可以作为奖励信号，用于评估和提升生成图像的情感与恢复质量。 这些发现将心理舒适确立为以人为本图像生成的一个独立维度，并将HealBench定位为情感感知生成模型的基础。
